name: Trade-In Box
text: At each shop, you may exchange one of your sigils with one of the offered sigils.
prototypeNote: At the shop, use Collection to swap one of your sigils for an offer, and put your sigil into the offers.

signature.target: one owned sigil for an offer of equal or lower rarity
signature.effect: free trade-in, not a sale or purchase

archetypes: Gold Miner, Diamond Flood, Swap Meet; any collection with a weak early sigil
decision: Every shop: which weak or off-plan sigil to give up, and whether the trade-in or the normal purchase should take the better offer.
aiNote: Trade in your lowest-value sigil when an offer of equal or lower rarity scores at least 10 a round more; with a full collection, always check the trade-in first.
rationale: A free upgrade each shop, worth a sell-and-buy plus the saved purchase, so a collection keeps improving after it fills at 13; the exchanged sigil goes into the shop's offers, and it never grows the collection.
